newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Texas Instruments raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Texas Instruments raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Erika Klauer said he raised his rating on Texas Instruments Inc to strong buy from hold.
-- He said he raised his 1996 operating earnings estimate to $2.15 from $1.75. His said his new 1997 and 1998 estimates for earnings per share were $3.00 and $4.00 versus $2.00 and $3.00 previously.
-- He said his 12-month price target was $80 based on a mutliple of 27 times his 1997 estimate.
-- Salomon made the change on Tuesday.

-- "We have always stated that once the transition away from commodity products was more complete the company would become more attractive because of its reduced exposure to commodity pricing," Klauer said in a research note. "We believe the time has come and the transition is complete."
-- Shares were trading at 61-3/4, up 3/4 in late morning exchange trading.
